pkgmetadata.longdescription: Unsloth Desktop is a Tauri-based GUI shell for running and training LLMs, diffusion, and audio models on local hardware. This binary package ships only the desktop UI (unsloth-studio); on first launch it bootstraps a private Python backend under ~/.unsloth/studio -- downloading uv, a dedicated CPython, PyTorch and the inference engine -- independently of the system sci-ml/unsloth stack. AMD ROCm is auto-selected on supported GPUs.
